card.name: Space before growth hormone doses
card.fires_on: The space just before a number in somatropin or growth hormone labels, after phrases like "less than", "dose of", "up to" or a condition name with a colon. Also fires on a few joining marks such as a hyphen or "and" in the same text.

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: The blank before a numeric dose or cutoff value in growth hormone dosing text.

modes.label: Joining marks in hormone text
modes.description: A hyphen, decimal point or "and" inside growth hormone wording or numbers.
